init_Hmmsearch: initialize an Hmmsearch wrapper with binary paths, database path, and optional e-value filter flags
query_with_hmm: query a sequence database using a prebuilt HMM profile string and return A3M results
query_with_a3m: query a sequence database by first building an HMM from an A3M input string
query_with_sto: query a sequence database by building an HMM from a Stockholm MSA with fast or hand model
review_Hmmsearch_class: review the Hmmsearch class to understand how it wraps the hmmsearch binary for sequence database searches
